summary: Spec acceptance criteria resolve through a third binding form, a work-item predicate reference of work_id plus predicate_id that the closed schema and the Go manifest model declare additively and authoring checks validate by shape, while discharge stays the work-item side's per-predicate verdict, and the law context resolves the dispatching work item's bindings so the packet lists which criterion each of its predicates discharges.
title: Spec criteria bind to work-item predicates
